note: Curated at development time. Attributions checked against well-documented primary or widely corroborated sources; wording follows the common English rendering. Cycles by day.

quotes.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
quotes.who: Albert Einstein (as recalled by John Archibald Wheeler)

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.
Whether you think you can, or you think you can't, you're right.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Courage is not the absence of fear, but rather the judgment that something else is more important than fear.
You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
What we fear doing most is usually what we most need to do.
Do the best you can until you know better. Then when you know better, do better.
Be curious, not judgmental.
Hard choices, easy life. Easy choices, hard life.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
You can't go back and change the beginning, but you can start where you are and change the ending.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
Talent is a pursued interest. Anything that you're willing to practice, you can do.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent, but the one most responsive to change.
Champions keep playing until they get it right.
I've missed more than 9,000 shots in my career. I've lost almost 300 games. I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
The more I practice, the luckier I get.
Pressure is a privilege.
Some people want it to happen, some wish it would happen, others make it happen.
You have to fight to reach your dream. You have to sacrifice and work hard for it.
I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
If you're going through hell, keep going.
Rivers know this: there is no hurry. We shall get there some day.
Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
quotes.who: Attributed to Leonardo da Vinci; popularized by Clare Boothe Luce

quotes.text: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
Well done is better than well said.
Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
Be so good they can't ignore you.
Amateurs sit and wait for inspiration, the rest of us just get up and go to work.
You don't have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
The time is always right to do what is right.
Life is either a daring adventure or nothing at all.
Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
Do not wait to strike till the iron is hot; but make it hot by striking.
Not all those who wander are lost.
Little by little, one travels far.
Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence.
It's not whether you get knocked down; it's whether you get up.
The harder the conflict, the more glorious the triumph.
What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make.
Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
I never lose. I either win or learn.
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.
Rien n'est impossible à celui qui essaie.
quotes.who: Alexander the Great (French rendering of the traditional saying)

quotes.text: Impossible n'est pas français.
On ne voit bien qu'avec le cœur. L'essentiel est invisible pour les yeux.
quotes.who: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, Le Petit Prince

quotes.text: Il faut cultiver notre jardin.
Je pense, donc je suis.
La vie, c'est comme une bicyclette, il faut avancer pour ne pas perdre l'équilibre.
Le succès, c'est d'aller d'échec en échec sans perdre son enthousiasme.
Ce qui ne me tue pas me rend plus fort.
Hope is being able to see that there is light despite all of the darkness.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
Believe you can and you're halfway there.
Comparison is the thief of joy.
It's kind of fun to do the impossible.
The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
Make each day your masterpiece.
Failure is not fatal, but failure to change might be.
Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
The expert in anything was once a beginner.
Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
Whatever you are, be a good one.
Give me six hours to chop down a tree and I will spend the first four sharpening the axe.
Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
How long are you going to wait before you demand the best for yourself?
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
A goal without a plan is just a wish.
Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
Success is a journey, not a destination. The doing is often more important than the outcome.
You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
Don't count the days, make the days count.
He who is not courageous enough to take risks will accomplish nothing in life.
Service to others is the rent you pay for your room here on earth.
You must be the change you wish to see in the world.
Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
Turn your wounds into wisdom.
The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
Everything is hard before it is easy.
Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.
What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?
A person who never made a mistake never tried anything new.
Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
Try not to become a man of success, but rather try to become a man of value.
Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
The good thing about science is that it's true whether or not you believe in it.
Never let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game.
It's hard to beat a person who never gives up.
The difference between the impossible and the possible lies in a person's determination.
You can't put a limit on anything. The more you dream, the farther you get.
If you want to be the best, you have to do things that other people aren't willing to do.
Set your goals high, and don't stop till you get there.
Persistence can change failure into extraordinary achievement.
Winning isn't everything, but wanting to win is.
It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
Only those who will risk going too far can possibly find out how far one can go.
Every strike brings me closer to the next home run.
Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
Learning never exhausts the mind.
